_comment: The vpc-provider entry below is a SYNTHETIC default-VPC shape keyed to the dummy account 000000000000. It exists so `CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=000000000000 CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 cdk synth` works offline (no AWS credentials). A real deploy runs with the real account id, which produces a different context key, so the CLI performs a real lookup and appends it here — this entry is never used for a deploy.
